[[File:Hadiya_Star_Wars_Dawn_of_the_Jedi_1.jpg|thumb|150px|[[Hadiya]], the Kral of Shikaakwa during the [[Despot War]]]]
'''Kral''' was the title of the overlord of the [[Nine Houses]] of the planet [[Shikaakwa]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. Prior to the [[Despot War]], the Nine Houses, feudal gangster clans led by an aristocracy, answered the Kral. [[Hadiya]] attempted to unite the Nine Houses and conquer the Tython system when she became Kral, which caused the Houses to revolt and ally with the [[Je'daii]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. This sparked the Despot War, which ended in [[25,805 BBY]] with the death of Hadiya.<ref name="DOTJ">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>
